scripts.docs:resources: pnpm brand:sync && pnpm theme:build && tsx apps/docs/scripts/component-docs.ts && pnpm registry:build && tsx apps/docs/scripts/public-usage.ts && tsx apps/docs/scripts/resources.ts && tsx tools/ai/build.ts
scripts.build: pnpm docs:resources && pnpm --filter @orvui/vue build && pnpm --filter @orvui/vue-mcp build && pnpm docs:build && tsx apps/docs/scripts/netlify-functions.ts
scripts.brand:sync: mkdir -p apps/docs/public/brand && cp assets/brand/*.svg apps/docs/public/brand/ && cp assets/brand/favicon.svg apps/docs/public/favicon.svg && cp assets/brand/favicon.svg assets/readme-logo.svg
scripts.typecheck: vue-tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && pnpm --filter @orvui/vue-mcp typecheck && pnpm docs:typecheck
scripts.check: pnpm build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
